units.time: base ticks; one base tick = TICK_MS of game time

deltatick.meaning: simDk = base ticks per simulation step. A periodic event of period P at phase φ fires in a step when some base tick of the step satisfies (t + φ) mod P == 0 (simStepCrosses).
deltatick.step_for_ms: ceil(ms / TICK_MS - 0.1), 1 when <= 1, at most SIM_DK_MAX

threads.role: Page (main thread): lockstep, network, input, rendering, UI. Runs the requestAnimationFrame loops (simulationFrame, _rafLoopFrame).
Simulation authority: runs the ticks (game scripts in a worker with a stand-in DOM). Starts the helpers and feeds them lane jobs (sim_parallel.js).
Helper of the simulation worker: takes chunks of lane jobs and parallel kernels.
Presentation reader: draws unit positions from the newest tick snapshot; never a simulation barrier.
Helper of the presentation worker (same file, name present-helper); count = min(3, cores/4 - 1).
Multi-point order split (assign_nearest.js), off the main thread.
Network quality background worker (timers while the page is hidden).

lanes.label: tick kernels
lanes.notes: The tick's own kernels on the simulation thread with the helpers (lane 0 is taken first).

lanes.label: unit index
lanes.notes: Next tick's unit index, built after a tick's end (spatialIndexPrebuild), waited for at the next tick.

lanes.label: state hash slices
lanes.notes: Rolling state hash, one slice per tick (SNAP_HASH_EVERY).

lanes.label: traffic solve
lanes.notes: Crowd traffic solve posted after each step's movement; its result is published two base ticks later (pending = gameTime + 2).

lanes.label: acquisition (enemy search)
lanes.notes: Enemy search; snapshot+scan posted at phase 2, commit at phase 0. Gate: SIM_ACQUIRE_TICKS.

lanes.label: units' cover (visibility)
lanes.notes: Renderer-side cover sweep over the units, posted at VIS_COVER_UNITS_PHASE. Lane shared with the adjacency flood.

lanes.label: adjacency flood
lanes.notes: Adjacency groups recalculated in batches: simStepCrosses(-3, ADJACENCY_BATCH_TICKS), i.e. at t mod 8 === 3.

lanes.label: worker search tier
lanes.notes: Workers' searches: post at WS_POST_PHASE, order at phase +1, commit at phase +2 (WS_TICKS cycle).

lanes.label: healer candidates
lanes.notes: Healer candidate scan, a round over HEALER_CANDIDATE_CACHE_TICKS, posted at the round's phase 0.

lanes.label: navigation fields
lanes.notes: Destination fields asked for in a tick, made by the next tick's flush.

lanes.label: navigation install
lanes.notes: Every live field remade over a new navigation build, before it is installed.

lanes.label: area boxes / path regions
lanes.notes: Tables made once in a while and taken when done.

lanes.label: wasm heap growth
lanes.notes: Wasm memory grown ahead of need (sim_wasm.js _simHeapGrowAhead).

findings.text: acquisition (enemy search): lane T10 is named for 10/s but its gate runs it at 5/s (period 4 ticks at TICK_RATE 20).
adjacency flood: lane T5 is named for 5/s but its gate runs it at 2.5/s (period 8 ticks at TICK_RATE 20).
worker search tier: lane T1 is named for 1/s but its gate runs it at 5/s (period 4 ticks at TICK_RATE 20).
healer candidates: lane T05 is named for 0.5/s but its gate runs it at 2/s (period 10 ticks at TICK_RATE 20).

85 of 95 JS kernels have no Rust twin found (by a "Rust:" note in their definition or an export of the same name). Either they have no Rust twin or the twin is not named in the way this scan looks for: SIM_KERNEL_VISIBILITY, SIM_KERNEL_SEPARATION, SIM_KERNEL_UNIT_FRAME, SIM_KERNEL_UNIT_PACK, SIM_KERNEL_SPATIAL_HISTOGRAM, SIM_KERNEL_SPATIAL_SCATTER, SIM_KERNEL_SEPARATION_PREPARE, SIM_KERNEL_SEPARATION_FINISH, SIM_KERNEL_MOVE, SIM_KERNEL_SEPARATION_YIELD, ....
